CheckTitle: AD agent pools have update settings and supported versions
Description: Checks AD agent pools have update settings and no agent below minimum supported version.
Risk: Outdated directory agents can miss security fixes and increase operational risk for identity integrations.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Directory > Directory Integrations.
2. Open the AD integration and select the Agents tab.
3. Review each agent's status and version.
4. Enable or schedule AD agent auto-update where available.
5. Update outdated agents, keeping at least two operational agents available during upgrades.

Recommendation.Text: Keep AD agent pools updated, configured for updates, and at or above Okta's minimum supported version.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
